name: get_profile
title: Read your Facehunch profile
description: Read the signed-in customer's own Facehunch account profile. Does not search for or identify other people.

name: get_report
title: Read an existing report
description: Read metadata and stored source links from an owned unlocked report. Similarity is not proof of identity. Locked results remain hidden; finish access in the product UI.

name: list_reports
title: List your reports
description: Browse existing owned reports. No search or identity inference is performed.
